proof_summary: Quadratic reciprocity makes 5 a square modulo p; choosing an even root r and setting n=r-1 gives the continuant numerator P₂=r²-5=pM with M<n. A telescoping continuant identity involving (n-1)! shows that M divides P₃ (using parity and coprimality with 2(n-2)), whereas p cannot divide P₃ since p>n, so reducing P₂/P₃ leaves numerator exactly p.
